snippet.title: What’s Summer Really Like in Abu Dhabi?
snippet.description:
During my stay at @Jumeirah Saadiyat Hotel, I visited the National Museum, the Natural History Museum, Teamlab Phenomena, House of Artisans, Ferrari world, The Butterfly Garden, The National Aquarium, Surf Abu Dhabi, The Bridge Wellness Club, Abu Dhabi Louvre, and I even tried an Emirati cooking class.

So, what is Abu Dhabi really like in summer? I found there was so much to do that 3 days wasn’t enough to get through everything. There was a huge selection of the indoor attractions, from museums to theme parks, to gyms and shopping malls. 

Abu Dhabi is definitely well set up for the heat, with lots of air-conditioned places to explore during the day, and more opportunities to explore outdoors in the evening. It’s a destination you don’t want to miss!
